name: @immunity-wars/dashboard
description: The results dashboard: static HTML built from suite results, with its caveats enforced by the type system
comment:no-client-js: Static HTML with inline CSS and inline SVG. No framework, no client JavaScript, no external requests: it is opened on a phone, often on a slow connection, and it must render instantly and work offline. It is also the instrument that reports on every other instrument, so it is a workspace member and is typechecked, linted and tested like anything else.
